description: On the countertop there’s an open cardboard box near the back, a purple ice-cube tray, a small white bottle, a tube, and a yellow lemon-shaped object. The right hand picks up the yellow lemon and flicks/throws it toward the far right side, then the left hand lifts the purple tray and tosses it into the open cardboard box; next the right hand grabs the small white bottle and flips it up and away, and finally the right hand picks up the tube and brings it closer to the camera.
